title: RISE Data Integration — 3.9M Patients, 42.6M Encounters
caption: RISE data flow through PortalNode-01 server
prompt: Create a photorealistic, technically detailed 3D engineering illustration of the RISE data integration pipeline as it flows through PortalNode-01. Begin at the left with a stylized representation of FHIR-enabled EHR data streams entering from 179 active practices, depicted as semi-transparent, deep navy (#1a1a2e) data cables converging into the server’s front panel. The server is an enterprise-grade, standard ATX chassis with visible RTX 4090 Founders Edition cards and an 8TB NVMe drive, all rendered in matte silver (#c0c0c0) with accent emerald (#00b894) highlights on active components. Inside, show a modular tokenization and de-identification unit (Datavant) as a distinct, glowing emerald module, followed by a knowledge graph node array on the NVMe, visualized as interconnected silver and emerald nodes. Illustrate the heuristic pre-extraction stage as a fast-moving data stream (1ms/page), with regex icons for ICD-10 codes, medications, and labs, before data reaches the LLM enrichment module, represented by a powerful, illuminated eoh-llama 8B processor. Next, show the patient timeline vision graph as a dynamic, branching structure, with a focus node labeled for 416,720 RA patients (ICD-10 M05/M06) using color-coded connections. The flare signal detection pipeline is depicted as a warm amber (#fdcb6e) path, highlighting power and thermal flows. End with a scored, structured, auditable patient timeline output—visualized as a clean, organized data array. Ensure all cable routing and airflow directions are visible, with subtle arrows and airflow guides. The background is a neutral dark gray gradient, evoking a high-end data center. No people or text overlays. Emphasize the scale: 3.9M patients, 42.6M encounters, and local-only processing.
